QuestInfo.name: 5 Different Paths of Cygnus Knights
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p1101002##k and see if he accepts you as a Knight-in-Training.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# showed you the 5 different paths of Cygnus Knights, suggesting that you decide what kind of knight you wish to become. A Dawn Warrior of sword and soul, a Blaze Wizard of magic and flame, a Wind Archer of bow and storm, a Night Walker of night and darkness, and a Thunder Breaker of knuckle and lightning. Which fits you the best? The choice is entirely yours.
